_ps_note: Pulse private memory + Shield (Security/Compliance) surface visibility (Intelligence & Coordination pillar).
system_message: Search for CEOs or VPs at medical device companies in the medtech sector who are in the AI SaMD and/or IVD/LDT space. Focus on those who announced their pursuit of FDA clearance more than one year ago but who still have not announced the receipt of that clearance, and those with recent staffing changes (e.g., regulatory affairs departure, layoffs). In addition, look in the 510k database and see if they used in-house staff to get their clearance, or if they list a consultant as their correspondent, and focus on those.
